executable.title: Spatial Aggregation
executable.description: Transfer properties from a base annotation layer (e.g., Spots) to spatially overlapping structures in target annotation layers (e.g., glomeruli, tubules)
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

image.name: input_image
image.label: Input Image
image.description: The whole slide image (WSI) containing the annotation layers to be processed

string.name: base_annotation
string.label: Base Annotation
string.description: Name of the source annotation layer containing properties to transfer (e.g., "Spots" with spatial omics data)

string.name: agg_annotation
string.label: Aggregation Annotation
string.description: Comma-separated list of target annotation layers to receive aggregated properties (e.g., "glomeruli, tubules"). Existing annotations with these names will be replaced with aggregated versions

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key
parameters.description: A Girder API URL and token for Girder client

string.name: girderToken
string.label: Girder API Token
string.description: A Girder token identifying a user session
